title: Probabilistic Machine Learning for Short-Term Atmospheric Seeing Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.29654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate short-term forecasting of atmospheric seeing is of significant interest for astronomical observations and free-space optical communication systems, where rapid variations in optical turbulence can affect system performance and operational planning. In this work, we benchmark machine learning models for predicting atmospheric seeing up to two hours in advance, with a particular focus on probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty quantification. We compare two probabilistic approaches, Gaussian Processes (GPs) and a normalizing-flow- based model (FloTS), against deterministic recurrent neural network (RNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) baselines. All models are trained and evaluated on seeing measurements from the Maunakea summit. We assess the models using both deterministic metrics, including the root mean square error and the Pearson correlation coefficient, and probabilistic metrics that evaluate the quality and calibration

translated_title: 用于短期大气视宁度预报的概率机器学习
translated_abstract: 准确的短期大气视宁度预报对于天文观测和自由空间光通信系统具有重要意义，因为光学湍流的快速变化会影响系统性能和运行规划。在本研究中，我们对能够提前最多两小时预报大气视宁度的机器学习模型进行了基准测试，并特别关注概率预报和不确定性量化。我们比较了两种概率方法——高斯过程（GP）和基于归一化流的模型——与确定性的循环神经网络（RNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）基线模型。所有模型均在莫纳克亚山顶的视宁度测量数据上进行训练和评估。我们使用确定性指标（包括均方根误差和皮尔逊相关系数）以及评估预报质量与校准程度的概率指标对模型进行评估。
tldr: 该论文将高斯过程和基于归一化流的概率模型与确定性RNN/LSTM基线进行对比，实现了莫纳克亚山顶大气视宁度提前至两小时的概率预报及不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks probabilistic machine learning models, including Gaussian Processes and a normalizing-flow-based FloTS, against deterministic RNN and LSTM baselines for forecasting atmospheric seeing up to two hours ahead at Maunakea, with a focus on probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty quantification.
